title: Run Output console re-splits and re-renders the entire 5000-line buffer on every 50ms chunk, on both the append and render sides
existing_state: runOutput is one monolithic string in the main canvas store: appendRunOutput concatenates the chunk then splits the ENTIRE buffer on newlines and re-joins it (up to 5000 lines / hundreds of KB) to enforce the cap on every message (FlowCanvas/src/stores/slices/executionSlice.ts:119-127). The host throttles output to 50ms batches and forwards each flush via SendRunOutputAppend (Form1.cs:118, 332, 13977-13985), so verbose multi-host runs fire this ~20x/second — and execution-started auto-switches the dock to the Run tab so the console is mounted during runs (stores/messageBridge.ts:215-222, 333-341). On the render side RunOutputView re-derives all lines per update (full split + per-line trailing-CR replace, RunOutputView.tsx:46) and re-renders the complete list — up to 5000 divs with index keys, each re-running the classifyRunOutputLine regex when Color is on and the highlight() substring scan when Find is open, with no virtualization (panels/RunOutputView.tsx:127-135, 164-177); matchCount additionally rescans the whole lowercased buffer per chunk (32-39). Because runOutput lives in the main canvas store, each append also wakes every canvas subscriber (edges, blocks — compounding the selector-scan finding). The detached run-output window (?panel=runoutput) runs the identical component full-time.
recommendation: Store the console as a line array (ring buffer): split only the incoming chunk, append, and drop from the head — O(chunk) instead of O(buffer); carry the trailing partial line separately. Render via a memoized per-line Row component (line text + color mode + query as props) so unchanged lines skip reconciliation, classify each line once at append time, and add simple windowed rendering (fixed-height monospace rows make manual virtualization ~50 lines of code — no library needed). Compute matchCount incrementally or only while the find bar is open and the query changes. Consider moving runOutput into a small separate vanilla zustand store so 20Hz console churn never wakes canvas subscribers.
user_benefit: Verbose runs against a fleet stream into the Run Output tab (and detached window) without making the whole canvas WebView chug at exactly the moment the user is watching live wires and block states.

evidence.note: appendRunOutput splits the full buffer per chunk to enforce MAX_RUN_OUTPUT_LINES=5000
full-buffer matchCount scan, full re-split, full 5000-row map with per-line regex classify + highlight, index keys, no virtualization
host batches output every 50ms (UiOutputThrottleMs) then SendRunOutputAppend per flush — up to 20 chunks/sec reach React
execution-started auto-switches the dock to the Run tab, so the console is mounted during runs
